reviews.classification: complete historical combat or guide receipt/brief with matched later evidence and scope gaps
reviews.disposition: The tempo runner adopts the existing encounter/finish consumers and retains the legacy duel rather than replacing pursuit state. Earliest-ready moves, safe hand-over, keyed draws and witness effects are shown in a seeded1920road contest with real clicks, mid-fight reload and literal Export/Import; this is not earned whole-life or every-world proof. Banked away ticks are a game-time hold/repayment policy, not wall-clock catch-up. Minutes not folded into the saved fight can be lost on reload in this version. P5 later records held minutes surviving and replaces approximate rival/helper stats with the shared Enemy derivation, explicitly closing F-P4-2. P7 later replaces immediate withdrawal with a real attempt. The parked notes shelf/shortcut defect remains a named UI-owner finding. The same receipt lists condition mishaps as present in its table and absent under limits: retain that internal evidence conflict for source inspection before any mishap claim. Reactions/channelled actions, deceptive intent and attrition are not established. Exact bundle/fixture and click method remain recorded; an unspecified commit-record suite is not a fresh verified pass.
